description: Find members of the brand's Discord server by name: query matches the START of a username or nickname. Or read one member by userId. Returns each member's id (what send_discord_dm, assign_discord_role and remove_discord_role take), name and roles. Free.

brand.description: WHICH PROFILE the post lives in — id or exact name from list_brands (a shared workspace: its profile id). Needed when it was published in a profile this connection is not pinned to; applies to THIS CALL ONLY. A name that matches no profile, or two, is REFUSED and nothing is done.

discordServer.description: which Discord server (id or name) when the bot is in several

query.description: the start of a username or nickname, up to 100 characters

name: search_discord_members
title: Find a Discord server member
